[[File:Jim Lafferty DecipherCon 2000 videoclip.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Jim Lafferty at [[DecipherCon 2000]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''James Lafferty''' (Jim Lafferty) finished 4th at the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]. He was a 1998 World Finalist and reached the 1999 main event through the DecipherCon Wild Card (2nd).<ref name="lafferty-dd" /> He played all three days of 1999 Worlds.

In Great Falls, Montana, he ran an early sealed-deck demo tournament won by [[Michael Girard]].<ref name="decsq-girardmichael">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/girardmichael.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Gold 120 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000604073410/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/girardmichael.html Internet Archive]</ref>
